唐耀（唐耀（第22页）要知道这些战士都是天界生命，对神祗力是不排斥的。甚至多少还能考身体自主去吸收这些神祗力提升自己的修为，林锋现在培养他们，为的是等到了天界又更好的可以持续战斗的帮手。虽然他并没有明说，但是却可以很清楚的发现，陆无暇明显要比两个多月前瘦了很多，原本瓷娃娃一般精致的面容此刻虽然一样可爱，但却明显多了一丝憔悴。眼见顾南沉默着不说话，似乎陷入犹豫，身为影仆的端木茵还没太多感觉，端木森却着急了。吃惯用灵泉水浇灌的食材后，田诗诗和于露的口味都很叼，总感觉这饭菜没什么滋味。“什么！老祖突破到了炼体初期了！什么情况？”雷煞白骨精双目圆瞪，一副不敢相信的样子。穆三少刚才在车上也说过，有时候明知道牌很烂，他还是大胆往里边扔钱，以为可以赢回来。张大强本来一脸恭敬，现在面上多了几分怀疑。他也觉得眼前的年轻人穿着打扮太低调了点。由于尸体保存完好，没有被影躯切片，所以连身躯都完整继承下来，只是心脏已经不会跳动，血液也不再流淌。他认为顾南必定正躲在众神世界的某个角落，暗暗舔舐着自己的伤口，等待伤势完全复原的那一刻，继续出来猎杀主神。没想到，这个大树，还真的是夜风大人的手下，而且还是比宠物还要低一级的宠奴。藤溪、狂逸和阴疲，则眉头大皱，感觉脸上发烧，他们从来没有想过，有朝一日，自己的耳朵会被如此严重的污染。

> Chapter 120 Tang Yao (Page 1)
Tang Yao (Tang Yao (p. 22)) must know that these warriors are all beings in the heaven and are not repulsive to the power of gods. They can even test their bodies to absorb the power of gods to improve their own cultivation. Lin Feng is training them now in order to have better helpers who can continue to fight when they reach the heaven. Although he did not say it clearly, it can be clearly discovered that Lu Wuxia is obviously much thinner than he was more than two months ago. He was originally as energetic as a porcelain doll. Although Zhi's face was still cute at the moment, it was obviously more haggard. Seeing that Gu Nan was silent and seemed to be hesitating, Duan Muyin, as a shadow servant, didn't feel much, but Duan Musen was anxious. After eating food that was watered with spiritual spring water, Tian Shishi and Yu Lu felt that the food was tasteless. "What! The ancestor has broken through to the early stage of body training! What's going on?" Leisha White Bone Essence stared wide-eyed. He looked like he believed it. Mu Sanshao had just said that sometimes he would throw money in even though he knew the cards were bad, thinking he could win back. Zhang Daqiang had a respectful look on his face, but now he felt that the young man in front of him was dressed too low-key. Even the body was intact, but his heart was no longer beating and his blood was no longer flowing. Because Gu Nan must be hiding in a corner of the world of gods, secretly licking his wounds, waiting for the moment when the injury is completely recovered, and continues to hunt the main god. Unexpectedly, this big tree is really Lord Yefeng's subordinate, and he is a pet slave lower than a pet. Tengxi, Kuangyi and Yinwei frowned and felt their faces were burning. They had never thought that one day, their ears would be so seriously contaminated.
